page_title: FRA 3-1 POL | France v Poland 04/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' 3 - 1 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Poland) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Hugo Lloris into the bottom left corner.
90+9' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+8' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and Poland will have to take the penalty again!
90+8' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) fails to score from the penalty spot. The goalkeeper reads his intentions and comfortably saves the drilled shot directed to the middle of the goal.
90+8' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' It’s a PENALTY to Poland after the VAR review!
90+7' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Poland! Let's see what he decides.
90+6' That looked a certain handball by Dayot Upamecano (France) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+4' The linesman signals that Arkadiusz Milik (Poland) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+3' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
90+2' That's the end of the game for Jules Kounde, who is replaced by Axel Disasi (France).
90+1' 3 - 0 Goal! Marcus Thuram provides Kylian Mbappe (France) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 3:0.

79' Arkadiusz Milik (Poland) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

58' Jesus Valenzuela couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Raphael Varane (France) and blew his whistle.

47' Jesus Valenzuela shows a yellow card to Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) for his blatant foul.

32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aurelien Tchouameni (France) was quite harsh and Jesus Valenzuela didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

13' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) commits a rough foul. Jesus Valenzuela stops the game and makes a call.
11' Kylian Mbappe (France) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
11' Antoine Griezmann (France) works the corner short.
11' Ousmane Dembele (France) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. France can continue in their attacking effort.

7' Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
7' Theo Hernandez (France) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Valenzuela no option but to blow his whistle.

4' Raphael Varane (France) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
